svg.text: STAGE 449 · TOPIC 89 · SVG 93 · 🎉 HISTORIC 901-GUARDRAIL, 910-PROBE & 720-LIVE-POC MILESTONE (P891–P892)
Enterprise SIP RFC 6665 & RFC 4235 Dialog Event BLF Anti-Hijack & NOTIFY Storm Guard
Eliminating BLF XML Dialog-Tag Call-Pickup Hijacking, Unsolicited NOTIFY Injection & 50x XML Fan-Out Storms
🎉 901 GUARDS · 910 PROBES · 720 POC
452 Dims · 91 FAQs · 891 Tests
❌ Legacy RFC 3265/4235: BLF Tag Leak & 50x NOTIFY Storm
1. RFC 4235 dialog-info+xml Call-ID / Tag Leak (Call-Pickup Hijack)
• Presence server broadcasts <dialog call-id="c99" local-tag="L1"
remote-tag="R1"> in plaintext XML to all BLF status watchers.
• Any unauthorized extension harvests the tuple and sends INVITE with
Replaces: c99;to-tag=L1;from-tag=R1 to silently steal the VIP call!
Result: Trivial Cross-Extension VIP Call Interception via BLF Subscription
2. Unsolicited Out-of-Dialog NOTIFY & 8,000 pkt/s XML Fan-Out Storm
• Legacy RFC 3265 accepts unsolicited NOTIFY without prior SUBSCRIBE,
allowing spoofed Event: refer / check-sync command injection.
• Unthrottled Trying→Proceeding→Early→Confirmed transitions trigger
50×4×40 = 8,000 XML NOTIFY packets/sec during peak call bursts!
Result: Presence Server CPU Exhaustion & Spoofed NOTIFY State Injection
✅ RFC 4235 Tag Redaction (P891) & RFC 6665 Throttle Guard (P892)
P891 (🎉 900th Guard!) · RFC 4235 XML Tag Redaction & [300, 3600]s Expires
• Enforces Directed-Pickup ACL before emitting dialog-info+xml tags.
• Strips call-id, local-tag, remote-tag & remote URI for read-only BLF
watchers (emits <state>early/confirmed</state> lamp state only).
• Clamps SUBSCRIBE Expires to [300, 3600] seconds (0 leaked tag payloads)!
clampedUnredactedDialogTagLeakPayloads = 0 · Expires ∈ [300, 3600]s
P892 (🎉 901st Guard!) · RFC 6665 481 Reject & [100, 1000]ms NOTIFY Throttle
• 100% Rejects unsolicited out-of-dialog NOTIFY with SIP 481 in 0ms.
• Clamps Min-Notify-Interval throttle window to [100, 1000]ms (250ms),
coalescing rapid Trying→Early→Confirmed transitions by 75%+.
• Immediate memory reaper on Subscription-State: terminated!
clampedUnsolicitedOrUnthrottledNotifyStormPackets = 0 · Throttle ∈ [100, 1000]ms
📊 Stage 449 Quantitative Convergence & Timing Provenance Disclosure (🎉 901-Guardrail, 910-Probe & 720-Live-POC Milestone)
